title: Spell the champions the way the person table already does
description: Decision 3 of docs/open-decisions-2026-08-03.md, recommended for application and never applied to the game records. people.tsv was curated with Wikidata identities on 2026-07-31 and again on 08-03; wch.tsv kept the corpus strings, so the same human is 'Capablanca, José Raúl' in one file and 'Capablanca, Jose' in another. Six of the eight are PGN middle initials, two are diacritics the repo has already normalised elsewhere. Every target is a curated display name with a QID behind it, and every link runs through events.tsv rather than through a surname.
